mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL time signals more at-home substitution and fewer discretionary outings, so retail visits should drop within one to two weeks and stay weaker through the month.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rebounds to above its last-4-week mean while PARKS remains elevated for two straight weeks.
